Name: snowballstemmer
Version: 2.0.0
Summary: This package provides 26 stemmers for 25 languages generated from Snowball algorithms.
Home-page: https://github.com/snowballstem/snowball
Author: Snowball Developers
Author-email: snowball-discuss@lists.tartarus.org
License: BSD-3-Clause
Description: 
        It includes following language algorithms:
        
        * Arabic
        * Basque
        * Catalan
        * Danish
        * Dutch
        * English (Standard, Porter)
        * Finnish
        * French
        * German
        * Greek
        * Hindi
        * Hungarian
        * Indonesian
        * Irish
        * Italian
        * Lithuanian
        * Nepali
        * Norwegian
        * Portuguese
        * Romanian
        * Russian
        * Spanish
        * Swedish
        * Tamil
        * Turkish
        
        This is a pure Python stemming library. If `PyStemmer <https://pypi.org/project/PyStemmer/>`_ is available, this module uses
        it to accelerate.
